about: Research sites for the built-in web source and the access scan (references/access-scan.md). Entries marked library-consensus come from a union of the public A-Z database lists of 119 university libraries worldwide, kept when named by at least 10% of them in 3+ regions (tier common) or 25% in 5+ regions (tier core); access, owner type and terms readings follow the published heuristic at https://github.com/lukewp/library-consensus-sources. Entries marked open-web are cited in the most-read Wikipedia articles of 15+ of 20 languages, are among the 5 sources most cited in one language, or are linked from the news, free-web, data or government guides of 10%+ of libraries in 3+ regions; open-web-curated are seed-list sources below those thresholds, assessed the same way. Entries marked curated were added by hand. automation is the stricter (spirit) reading of robots.txt and terms; automation_letter is the reading by the letter. Neither is legal advice: the user's own agreements govern, and a profile can override any entry.
